race.comment: MACKEL SONNY (7) is in good form with top-three finishes at his last five starts, most recently recording a second at this circuit and distance after breaking early. Runner-up from a tougher handicap than this prior. With manners he can break through. BUSTER DAN (9) had to work last start so forgive that result. Won from a standing start at this circuit and distance last month so could put himself back into the winners' stall. FENOMENAL (8) didn't do a bad job when fourth here last time out. GAZ MAN NZ (6) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third. Can feature again.
